items.title: Auto ancillary sector growth outlook positive, but near-term margin pressure likely: Report
items.summary: India’s auto bearings and ancillary sector is poised for strong medium-term growth, driven by rising bearing content per vehicle, robust demand across PV, CV, and 2W segments, and steady support from railways and industrial sectors like wind, cement, and steel. However, near-term profitability may be impacted by input cost volatility, higher raw material and energy prices, and transition-related expenses.
